name: Yamuna Builders
description:
Yamuna Builders (Yamuna Homes & Design Pvt. Ltd.) was established with a vision to redefine the real estate landscape of Karnataka by setting uncompromising standards for quality. With a foundational journey that began in 1993 through specialized drilling and earth-moving enterprises, the company brings decades of deep, ground-up expertise to every project.

Under the leadership of Managing Director Purushotham R. Shetty, Yamuna Builders witnessed how a lack of integrity and transparency in the sector could compromise a client's trust and investment. Driven by a commitment to innovation, sustainability, and excellence, the company built its reputation on closing the gap between a developer's promise and the final delivery.

Their approach ensures that every client can invest in world-class residential and commercial developments, like the landmark Yamuna Sky City, with complete confidence, knowing their home is not only a functional, luxurious space but also a reliable, high-quality asset.
